summary: TODO-001 satisfies the approved DB/API acceptance criteria. The implementation adds exactly one new migration for the per-session static URL switch and token-only RPC, wires the boolean through store/types/API responses without exposing token/UID material, preserves SUN handling, and provides sufficient local API/static validation evidence. No blockers found.
warnings: Hosted validation is intentionally deferred until FINAL_REVIEW after the user applies the new migration, per the approved plan.

Admin PATCH with allowStaticUrl would fail before the hosted migration is applied because the column is absent; this deploy-order limitation is documented in the implementation manifest and TODO-001 has no UI that sends the field yet.
evidence: Migration `supabase/migrations/20260928100000_static_tag_switch.sql:5` adds `allow_static_url boolean not null default false`; lines 9-132 define `record_static_tag` with switch checks before/after team lock, token lookup scoped to the participant session, SUN-equivalent race rules, and service_role-only execute grants.

`src/app/api/tag/route.ts:16-22` routes only token-shaped bodies without `e`/`c` to `store.recordStaticTag`; malformed token/UID-only bodies return the existing `태그 정보가 없습니다.` path. Lines 24-35 keep SUN verification and `recordSunTag` handling unchanged for `e`/`c`.

`src/lib/db.ts:44-45` maps the new column defensively; `src/lib/db.ts:274-275` updates it only for boolean patches; `src/lib/db.ts:501-512` calls the new RPC and preserves old 400 behavior when the function is absent.
`src/app/api/admin/sessions/[id]/route.ts:22-35` accepts `allowStaticUrl` as `unknown` and passes it only when it is a strict boolean, preserving admin auth checks at lines 18-20.
`src/lib/race.ts:181-188` adds only `allowStaticUrl` to the participant session view while tag/nextTag narrowing remains token-free.

Static validation evidence at `.ai/tasks/active/TASK-20260928-001/runtime/static/TODO-001/summary.txt` records `VALIDATE_STATUS=PASSED`, `LINT_BASELINE=MATCH`, and `TSC_EXIT=0`; `lint-delta.txt` says `no new lint findings`.

API evidence `.ai/tasks/active/TASK-20260928-001/evidence/TODO-001/api-check-static.local.out.txt` records `ALL PASS` and covers switch-off byte-equal 400/no-write behavior, switch-on race rules, mixed SUN/static mode, concurrency, UID-only rejection, strict admin PATCH, leak scanning, and anon privilege rejection.

Migration hash evidence shows the six existing migration hashes unchanged and only `20260928100000_static_tag_switch.sql` added; catalog evidence confirms the column is NOT NULL default false and `record_static_tag` has execute only for `service_role`.
`npm run test:sun` evidence records 11 passing SUN crypto/regression tests.
regressions_checked: Switch-off `{token}`/`{uid}`/empty requests remain byte-equal 400 and write no `tag_events`, `sun_counters`, or team timestamps.
SUN path remains selected whenever `e`/`c` are present, including malformed SUN fields with a token present.
Mixed mode preserves SUN replay and baseline rejection in switch-on sessions.
Participant `/api/me`, `/api/tag`, and `/api/join` responses were scanned for test tokens, UIDs, and key material; only the boolean switch field is newly exposed.

No browser runtime report was required because TODO-001 changes DB/API behavior and no UI, navigation, user interaction, or visible browser flow; static validation and scripted API runtime checks cover the changed behavior.
